name: loom
description: Loom: shared long-term memory and code intelligence for AI coding agents, self-hosted on ClickHouse.

plugins.name: loom
plugins.description: Shared long-term memory and code intelligence for Claude Code: MCP tools to save and recall decisions across sessions, hooks that capture each session with no model call, and a code index that answers structure questions without whole-file reads.

plugins.name: loom-code-skill
plugins.description: Code search and code intelligence for repositories in a Loom code index: an Agent Skill that finds the function or file with code.* first, then reads only that. Skill only, no hooks.
